items.primary_content:
Critically review the attached paper (Attention Is All You Need) as a conference reviewer. Identify and list at least twelve distinct, detailed limitations, threats to validity, unaddressed assumptions, missing experiments, methodological weaknesses, and under-supported claims, including both author-acknowledged and reviewer-identified issues, each with a short citation to the PDF.
1. Extract Acknowledged Limitations and Future Work
2. Analyze Model Architecture and Structural Weaknesses
3. Analyze Experimental Setup, Hyperparameters, and Evaluation Gaps
4. Synthesize and Refine Twelve Distinct Limitations (after todo-1, todo-2, todo-3)

research_plan.objective: Critically review the attached paper (Attention Is All You Need) as a conference reviewer. Identify and list at least twelve distinct, detailed limitations, threats to validity, unaddressed assumptions, missing experiments, methodological weaknesses, and under-supported claims, including both author-acknowledged and reviewer-identified issues, each with a short citation to the PDF.

steps.title: Extract Acknowledged Limitations and Future Work
steps.description: Search the PDF for sections discussing conclusions, future work, or limitations (typically Section 7 or the end of Section 6) to identify what the authors themselves acknowledge as limitations or areas for improvement.
steps.completion_criteria: A list of author-acknowledged limitations and future work directions with page and section citations.
evidence_expectations: Specific quotes or summaries of limitations mentioned by the authors.
Citations to the relevant sections/pages of the PDF.

steps.title: Analyze Model Architecture and Structural Weaknesses
steps.description: Examine Section 3 (Model Architecture) and Section 4 (Why Self-Attention) to identify structural limitations, such as the quadratic computational complexity of self-attention with respect to sequence length, the reliance on positional encodings to replace recurrence/convolution, and the assumption that position-wise feed-forward networks (which are 1D convolutions) do not violate the 'dispensing with convolutions' claim.
steps.completion_criteria: Detailed analysis of at least 4 structural or architectural limitations with citations to specific subsections, equations, or tables.
evidence_expectations: Analysis of self-attention complexity ($O(n^2 \cdot d)$) vs recurrent/convolutional complexity.
Analysis of positional encodings (sinusoidal vs learned) and their generalization limits.
Analysis of the role of position-wise feed-forward networks.

steps.title: Analyze Experimental Setup, Hyperparameters, and Evaluation Gaps
steps.description: Examine Section 5 (Training) and Section 6 (Results), including Table 3 (Model Variations) and Table 4 (Parsing), to identify methodological weaknesses, hyperparameter sensitivity, hardware constraints (e.g., training on 8 P100 GPUs), training instability (e.g., warmup steps, learning rate schedule), and gaps in evaluation (e.g., limited task variety, lack of comparison on longer sequences or non-translation tasks).
steps.completion_criteria: Detailed analysis of at least 5 experimental, hyperparameter, or evaluation limitations with citations to specific tables, sections, or pages.
evidence_expectations: Analysis of hyperparameter sensitivity based on Table 3.
Analysis of hardware and training cost constraints.
Analysis of evaluation limitations (e.g., English constituency parsing setup, lack of diverse NLP tasks).

steps.title: Synthesize and Refine Twelve Distinct Limitations
steps.description: Synthesize the findings from the previous steps into a comprehensive list of at least twelve distinct, detailed limitation items. Ensure each item is clearly categorized (e.g., architectural, experimental, evaluation, or hyperparameter), thoroughly explained from a reviewer's perspective, and supported by a precise citation to the PDF.
steps.completion_criteria: A final list of at least 12 highly detailed, distinct limitation items with citations, ready for synthesis.
evidence_expectations: At least 12 distinct, well-reasoned limitation items.
Each item must have a clear citation to the PDF.
No short summary; the focus is entirely on the detailed limitations.

definition_of_done: At least twelve distinct, detailed limitation items are identified and described.
Each limitation item includes a specific, short citation to the PDF (e.g., section, page, or table).
The review covers both author-acknowledged limitations and critical reviewer-identified weaknesses.
The analysis covers model architecture, experimental design, hyperparameter sensitivity, and evaluation gaps.
No short summary is provided; the detailed review of limitations is the main focus.
